title: Properties keys starting with # or ! disappear from the Environment: write the first character as a unicode escape
symptom: Entries such as '\#general=...' and '\!oncall=...' in a .properties file imported through spring.config.import are missing from the Environment, so lookups return null, while keys like 'dm' load fine.
cause: Boot's properties reader decodes a backslash escape before it decides whether the line is a comment, so a line starting with an escaped # or ! is turned into a comment and skipped.
fixSummary: Avoid a literal backslash escape for the first character of such keys and write it as a unicode escape instead, for example \u0023general=... and \u0021oncall=... in the file. The reader then sees an ordinary key character and keeps the entry, and the Environment returns the value under the original name.
